# HorizonsAI

> Off-market commercial real estate deal sourcing for acquisition teams. We read
> public filings, court and county records, loan servicing data and market
> channels to surface opportunities months before a property is listed, each one
> scored against the buyer's own acquisition criteria.

## What we do
HorizonsAI monitors more than $2 trillion in commercial real estate debt and
reads the public record for signs that a commercial property is heading toward
a sale — long ownership tenure, probate and estate filings, lis pendens, tax
delinquency, loan maturity inside 24 months, occupancy decline and more than
thirty other signals. Each opportunity is delivered with the owner resolved to
a named human and every figure linked to the filing it came from. That work
has surfaced $4.2 billion of asset value and 2,800 opportunities, with a
median lead of 94 days before a listing.

## Who it is for
Commercial real estate acquisition teams: syndicators, private equity,
owner-operators, family offices and REITs.

## Asset classes
Industrial, multifamily, retail, office, outdoor storage and flex.

## What we are not
We are not a broker and take no commission on any transaction. We are not a
property database — we do the finding and scoring rather than handing over a
search tool.

## Pages
- [Off-market CRE deal sourcing](https://www.horizonsai.co/): How the pipeline is configured to a buy box, what lands on the desk, and how it compares with brokers, bought lists, and hiring an analyst.
- [How we find deals](https://www.horizonsai.co/how-we-find-deals): The public records read before a property is listed — ownership and succession, pressure on title, the debt, and how the asset is running.
- [Book a call](https://www.horizonsai.co/book-a-call): Schedule a call to see coverage in your markets.
